summary: Alvotech filed a Form 6-K disclosing it secured a $75 million additional term loan facility led by GoldenTree Asset Management, maturing December 31, 2027, amending its existing credit agreement. This follows a $165 million equity raise announced June 18, 2026, giving access to $240 million total. The filing is a routine financing update and does not constitute a special situation such as a going-private, tender offer, or restructuring. The proceeds support R&D and product launches. No deal terms such as price or premium apply.
